newsitem.title: USA: MGI PHARMA data positive on Salagen.
newsitem.headline: MGI PHARMA data positive on Salagen.

text.p: MGI PHARMA Inc said Monday the first available data from a human clinical trial of the company's Salagen Tablets showed a positive response among Sjogren's Syndrome patients using the drug for treating dry mouth and dry eyes.

It said the overall clinical trial involved 629 patients, who were treated over a 12-month period. MGI is analyzing the data collected from the trial to request approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market Salagen Tablets for Sjogren's Syndrome, a chronic, inflammatory disease that attacks moisture producing glands.
